notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.content: [h2]What's new[/h2][p]-New progress reset system! Earn precious diamonds in exchange for your progress. Would you dare to start all over again?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/2cb8b0cf772983e28e2cdc5c415624f3585b331a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]-New menu with permanent upgrades available for diamonds! Exchange your diamonds for a permanent, stackable bonus to your Kibbles per Second![/p][p][i]Currently, only one upgrade is available, but a batch of new upgrades are planned.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/df70c281d789447b700ff7bed8d715fc2156380d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]-New Steam achievements added accordingly! Accept the challenge to start all over again, and spend your first diamonds![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/c23c08e0182ab62d52b3d2da664352367daee190.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]PATCH[/h2][p]-Now you can choose your game background from all the ones you have purchased! Gone are the days when it was impossible to choose the background you had loved so much and where you had to play with the recently purchased one.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/faa3edd20a41307f80ebb53f84fd1ac33b54b2b6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]And finally... thank you![/h2][p]Lately, I've received many positive reviews of the game. Thank you for your patience and your perspective on the overall state of the game. I take the time to read and respond to each of them with pleasure. Your comments greatly encourage me to continue improving CroquettesClicker![/p][p]Your comments mean a lot to me![/p]

notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.content: [h2][b]Added[/b][/h2][p]- The game now features a custom Discord status, with the game icon, your total number of Croquettes, and your number of Croquettes per second. Proudly show everyone how far you've come in conquering the world![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344227/5db236e2d987c118dc7f33b36036ebd722daad08.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]-A new button has appeared in the shop, but for the moment it is still locked... Could it be hiding something grandiose?[/p]

notes.title: Mise à jour d'amélioration
notes.content:
[h2][b]Visual Change[/b][/h2]
- The unlockable in-game wallpapers have [i](finally!)[/i] [b]been improved![/b]

[b][h2]Adjustments[/h2][/b]
- The rewards for the [i]Paw Challenge[/i] have been reduced from a reward of [b]10% to 3%[/b] of your total kibble.

notes.title: Patchnote
notes.content:
[b]Previously, only values ​​below 1e9[/b] were displayed correctly without scientific notation.
[b]Now[/b] display [b]support has been extended up to 1e303.[/b]

notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.content:
-Now [b]large numbers are much more readable[/b].
-A [b]daily reward[/b] has arrived! (@Suggestions discussion)

notes.title: PATCHNOTE
notes.content: The game is now available in windowed mode by default!

notes.title: Improvement Update
notes.content:
It is now possible to switch the game to [b]windowed mode[/b] by pressing [b]ESC[/b] during the game.

The cat remains in the foreground. A [i]minor correction[/i] remains to be made to adjust the size of the buttons depending on the window, and will be included in a future update.

notes.title: Patch update
notes.content:
[h2]Corrections[/h2]
-The prices of improvements have been lowered (@Suggestions discussion)
-Fixed the bowl which blocked clicks when purchasing it (@Suggestions discussion)
-Now the volume set for the music is saved (@Suggestions discussion)

notes.title: Patch
notes.content: Le bug de la gamelle qui bloque les clics a été fixé.

notes.title: Mise à jour d'amélioration
notes.content:
[h2]Corrections[/h2]
-Fixed the tooltip which was no longer displayed at the top of the game
-Fixed the icon displayed in the taskbar which displayed an image by default
-Correction of the price of the Paw Challenge mini-game which could be unlocked for 1 kibble.

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
-The price of all rewards as well as the price of all upgrades have been increased, to offer a greater number of hours of play than before.

notes.title: Mise à jour d'amélioration
notes.content:
[h2]Redesign[/h2]
-Change to the store: from now on, the current purchasable decoration elements [b]are now replaced by animated backgrounds[/b].
-Shop buttons are changed accordingly.

[h2]Corrections[/h2]
-The disappearance of the mini-game image [i]The Paw Challenge[/i] goes from 0.5 seconds to 0.65 seconds.
-Removal of the mini-game [i]Nimble Paw[/i], which caused a lot of problems in development, particularly linked to its lack of fluidity.
-Disabled hardware acceleration by default, to overcome an NVIDIA bug which caused the game to flash the first seconds after loading.

[h2]Steam Client[/h2]
-Updated and improved the presentation video.
-Updated screenshots.

notes.title: Mise à jour d'amélioration
notes.content:
[h2]Visual[/h2]
-Redesign of the store menu. From now on, purchases in the store are grouped by category, which offers a multitude of possibilities for adding to this tab. 
It is therefore possible to purchase visual improvements, but also additional mini-games.
-Change of the “Croquettes Clicker” text located at the top of the game with a logo, more visible.
-Purchased mini-games are now integrated into acquired mini-games.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
-Added a steam achievement
-Added a mini-game "The Challenge of the Paw", purchasable in the store.

notes.title: Mise à jour d'amélioration
notes.content:
[h2]Corrections[/h2]
-Fixed audio credit that displayed the wrong music title
-Fixed click animation that froze for a second on the screen
-Temporarily removed the "Achievements" button which is no longer in line with Steam achievements and requires a visual improvement
 -Removal of the “Credits” button. Credits will be displayed on the Steam store page rather than in-game.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
-Added 51 Steam achievements

notes.title: Update improvement
notes.content:
[h2]Visual[/h2]
-Improved the appearance of upgrade buttons, shop buttons and mini-game buttons.
-Better readability of buttons with changing the font.
-Added a slight background to each button category to better distinguish the different menus.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
-Added levels for each improvement.
